scripts.typecheck: npm run build:types && npm run typecheck:types && npm run typecheck:backend && npm run typecheck:web && npm run typecheck:mobile
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:web
scripts.test:unit: npm --workspace=@repo/backend run test:unit && npm --workspace=web run test:unit && npm --workspace=mobile run test
scripts.test:unit:ci: node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('artifacts/unit',{recursive:true})" && npm --workspace=@repo/backend run test:unit:ci && npm --workspace=web run test:unit:ci && npm --workspace=mobile run test:ci
scripts.test:coverage: npm --workspace=@repo/backend run test:unit:coverage && npm --workspace=web run test:unit:coverage
scripts.test:e2e:regression: npm --workspace=web run test:e2e:regression && npm --workspace=web run test:admin-accessibility
scripts.test:admin-assurance: npm --workspace=@repo/backend run test:admin-assurance && npm --workspace=web run test:e2e
scripts.test:quality: npm --workspace=@repo/backend run test:quality && npm --workspace=web run test:unit:coverage
scripts.test:guards: npm run test:module-boundaries && npm run test:prisma-architecture && npm --workspace=@repo/backend run test:contracts && npm --workspace=@repo/backend run test:tenant-isolation && npm --workspace=@repo/backend run test:tenant-runtime && npm --workspace=@repo/backend run test:security-hardening && npm --workspace=@repo/backend run test:permission-gating
scripts.test:fast: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:types-layout && npm run test:ci-infrastructure && npm run test:guards && npm run test:unit
scripts.test:full: npm run test:fast && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e:smoke && npm run test:e2e:regression && npm run build
scripts.build: npm --workspace=@repo/backend run db:generate && npm run build:types && npm --workspace=@repo/backend run build && npm --workspace=web run build
